"""Camera-guided controller used for this single door-lock episode.

The waypoints were selected from RGB/depth observations and calibration, then
checked visually after each contact. No simulator state, reset, benchmark
policy, or success signal is used. Per-stage actions and observations are
saved alongside this script as the exact executed record.

Running this file starts the recorded controller on the connected episode;
it was not run again after the final stable observation.
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def save(obs, name, cams):
    obs.save(str(OUT / name))
    canvas = Image.new('RGB', (640, 480))
    for i, cam in enumerate(cams):
        if cam in obs.last:
            im = Image.fromarray(obs.last[cam])
            im.save(OUT / name / f'{cam}.png')
            canvas.paste(im, ((i % 2) * 320, (i // 2) * 240))
    canvas.save(OUT / name / 'views.png')


def move_tcp(robot, spec, cams, target, name, speed=.25, absolute=True):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[])
    p = np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    if absolute:
        # Free-space proprioception established the TCP-to-mocap offset.
        delta = target + np.array([0., -.0055, .0488]) - p[4:7]
    else:
        delta = target - p[:3]
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / (.01 * speed))))
    actions = np.zeros((n + 30, 4), dtype=np.float64)
    actions[:n, :3] = delta / (.01 * n)
    actions[:, 3] = 1.0
    np.save(OUT / f'{name}_actions.npy', actions)
    result = robot.submit('ee_delta', actions, dt=spec['control_dt'],
                          cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video='both', note=name)
    save(result, name, cams)


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    cams = list(spec['cameras'])
    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
    save(obs, 'initial', cams)
    # Initial probing at the plate centre; subsequent depth views showed
    # rotation requires contact nearer the right free end.
    stages = [
        ([.004, .60, .31], '01_raise', .25, False),
        ([-.09, .69, .29], '02_above', .25, False),
        ([-.09, .69, .225], '03_contact', .10, False),
        ([-.09, .69, .175], '04_press', .08, False),
        ([-.09, .69, .29], '05_unload', .15, True),
        ([-.047, .683, .27], '06_edge', .12, True),
        ([-.047, .683, .18], '07_push_edge', .06, True),
        ([-.073, .683, .135], '08_turn_down', .06, True),
        ([-.073, .62, .28], '09_inspect_clear', .10, True),
    ]
    for target, name, speed, absolute in stages:
        move_tcp(robot, spec, cams, target, name, speed, absolute)
    final = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, seconds=2., include_depth=True, video='both')
    save(final, '10_final_stable', cams)
    # The lever remained vertically downward after release and settling.
    # Stop here: the final executed state is the state to be graded.


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
